fancyitems.configuration.title: Fancy Items Configuration
fancyitems.configuration.starburstEffect: A pulsing, rotating, starburst effect behind inventory items with a rarity or colored name
fancyitems.configuration.beamEffect.tool: A visually stunning beam effect for items on the ground with a rarity or colored name
fancyitems.configuration.enableFadeEffec: Whether to enable the fade effect for items at their render distance
fancyitems.configuration.enableStarburst: Whether to enable the starburst effect for items with a rarity or colored name
fancyitems.configuration.starburstRayCou: Number of rays in the starburst
fancyitems.configuration.starburstRayLen: Ray length as a percentage of the item size
fancyitems.configuration.starburstRayWid: Ray width as a percentage of the item size
fancyitems.configuration.starburstLength: Percentage of length added to each ray variation
Number of ray length variations before repeating
fancyitems.configuration.starburstWidthV: Percentage of width added to each ray variation
Number of ray width variations before repeating
fancyitems.configuration.starburstPulseL: Minimum ray length multiplier during pulsing
Maximum ray length multiplier during pulsing
fancyitems.configuration.starburstPulseW: Minimum ray width multiplier during pulsing
Maximum ray width multiplier during pulsing
fancyitems.configuration.starburstPulseD: Duration of the pulsing animation in ticks
fancyitems.configuration.starburstRotati: Duration of the rotation animation in ticks
fancyitems.configuration.starburstAnimat: Whether each starburst animation has a different offset
fancyitems.configuration.enableBeamEffec: Whether to enable the beam effect for items with a rarity or colored name
fancyitems.configuration.beamEffectStyle: Style used for the beam effect
fancyitems.configuration.beamEffectFadeD: Duration of the fade animation in ticks
fancyitems.configuration.beam.tooltip: A bright beam of energy emitting from the item
fancyitems.configuration.glow.tooltip: A subtle ground glow below the item
fancyitems.configuration.sparkles.toolti: A magical mist of sparkles rising above the item
fancyitems.configuration.sound.tooltip: A powerful and ominous sound resonating from the item
fancyitems.configuration.beamPlanes.tool: Number of planes used to form the beam
fancyitems.configuration.beamHeight.tool: Height of the beam in blocks
fancyitems.configuration.beamWidth.toolt: Width of the beam in blocks
fancyitems.configuration.beamPulseMin.to: Minimum width multiplier of the beam during pulsing
fancyitems.configuration.beamPulseMax.to: Maximum width multiplier of the beam during pulsing
fancyitems.configuration.glowScale.toolt: Size of the glow in blocks
fancyitems.configuration.glowPulseMin.to: Minimum scale multiplier of the glow during pulsing
fancyitems.configuration.glowPulseMax.to: Maximum scale multiplier of the glow during pulsing
Number of sparkles visible at once
fancyitems.configuration.sparklesDistanc: Percentage of beam height sparkles can travel
fancyitems.configuration.sparklesDriftAm: Distance sparkles can drift in blocks
fancyitems.configuration.sparklesDriftFr: Frequency sparkles can drift in ticks
fancyitems.configuration.soundPitchVaria: Percentage of pitch variation between beam sounds
fancyitems.configuration.soundPulseMin.t: Minimum volume multiplier of the beam sound during pulsing
fancyitems.configuration.soundPulseMax.t: Maximum volume multiplier of the beam sound during pulsing
